description: This file contains the code-behind for the AdminQueue webpage, managing session validation, database checks for course queue status, and navigation through server transfer events.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminQueue ASP.NET page, handling page load events, button clicks, and grid view selection changes.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, checks session variables, queries database for course queue status, and performs conditional cleanup.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control back to the same page, likely to refresh or navigate context.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the login page, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Captures selected row data from a GridView, stores relevant data in session variables, and navigates to the ShowAns page.
